abstention_rule: No hyperparameter, feature, threshold, bin, or mapping tuning after the battery runs. This is the LAST preregistered variant in the 0070-0072 budget. Whatever the outcome -- including a third negative -- it is recorded honestly with the measured mechanism. No variant D under these IDs.

baseline.formula: p_i^c = (1 + sum_{j<i} o_j) / (2 + (i-1)) -- Laplace-smoothed running base rate over PAST outcomes only, per domain, per seed
baseline.name: sequential_climatology

coupling_target.definition: corr(predicted_uncertainty, |actual_error|) per domain, pooled over seeds; u = 1-p for D1/D2/D4, u = p for D3; error channels UNCHANGED from CALIB-01/0070/0071 (total mean_abs_error etc.) -- no goalpost moving

decision_tree.if: Brier_est < Brier_climo on >=3/4 domains AND corr>=0.40 on >=3/4 domains
Brier win on >=3/4 but coupling gate fails
decision_tree.then: PARTIAL -- report the measured coupling honestly against the batch-oracle ceiling
NULL_HOLDS -- variant C is theater too; final negative-results entry with the full three-variant mechanism account

estimator_design.causality_rule: Unchanged: predict tick t from history < t + prediction-time fields; signed_error of tick t is an OUTCOME used only in post-prediction training (unit-tested no-leakage). rest_err history is maintained causally inside the estimator from past ticks' recorded signed_errors -- no new instrumentation, no future data.
estimator_design.ehat_head: for D1/D3 in mode C the ehat head trains on rest_err (E[|rest_err|]); the p heads always train on the preregistered (err, event). Reported: corr(ehat, |err_total|) [supplementary, preregistered definition] AND corr(ehat, rest_err) [diagnostic: honest coupling on the predictable component].
estimator_design.features: mode C = mode B feature set, except D1/D3's error-channel features (EMA_fast/slow, z-surprise) are computed on rest_err = mean(|signed_error[2:6]|) (obs dims 2-5, excluding pure-RNG cue dims 0-1) instead of total err. D2 (reward channel) and D4 (benefit) unchanged from mode B. Same 7+4 structure -- a clean ablation of the channel hypothesis.
estimator_design.mechanism_hypothesis: EXP-FP-0071's negative measured rest-channel lag-2 autocorr 0.24 vs total-error 0.13: the cue RNG was masking learnable structure INSIDE THE FEATURE CHANNEL ITSELF, not just diluting the target. Channel-decomposed features should therefore carry more signal than total-error features. Honest expectation stated BEFORE the run: the batch oracle with all features caps at corr 0.17 on total error, so 0.40 remains a stretch goal; variant C is a mechanism test of whether channel decomposition moves coupling toward the oracle ceiling (0.17), not a promise to hit 0.40.
estimator_design.why_not_theater: Same anti-theater instruments: climatology anchor, prequential evaluation, corr>=0.40 gate, anchor-only + permutation kill arms, unit-tested causality.

gates.degenerate_base_rate: base rate of o outside [0.02, 0.98] -> UNMEASURABLE

hypothesis: Channel-decomposed REST error features (excluding the pure-RNG cue channels from the feature channel) couple the causal online estimator to error magnitude: Brier beats climatology on >=3/4 domains AND corr(predicted_uncertainty, |actual_error|) >= 0.40 on >=3/4 domains.
instrumentation: InstrumentedArchB sidecar (already equivalence-proven in EXP-FP-0071); no new instrumentation. The replay additionally reads signed_error from the PredictionLog JSONL (recorded outcome, causal use only).
kill_attempt_preregistered: Same two kill arms on the same 4 seeds: (1) anchor-only (learn=False) reproduces Brier_climo to 1e-9; (2) error-permutation decomposition intact<permuted<climo. Plus novelty-zeroed ablation as in 0071.
limitations_preregistered: PROTOTYPE status: causal replay, not wired into act().
The p-head event definitions are unchanged from CALIB-01 (total error); only the estimator's internal feature channel is decomposed.
Honest ceiling noted: batch oracle corr 0.17 on total error; a perfect rest predictor caps at 0.629.

metric.Brier_climo: sequential Laplace running base rate per domain per seed
metric.Brier_est: mean((p_i - o_i)^2) from causal prequential replay, feature_mode='C'
metric.ECE: 10 equal-width bins, reported (CALIBRATED = Brier win AND ECE<=0.10 AND MCE<=0.25, reported not gated)
metric.corr_coupling: Pearson corr(predicted_uncertainty, |actual_error|) per domain -- the gated target

never_self_report: Only recorded PredictionLog JSONL + sidecar context + causally derived history. No self-assessment input; no tick-t (or later) outcome in tick-t's prediction.
null: Channel decomposition adds nothing: Brier_est >= Brier_climo on every domain AND/OR corr < 0.40 everywhere (variant C is theater too).
